M-CHECKBOX-WIDGET.Purpose: Native single-boolean controlled checkbox reporting user-proposed changes without writing the externally owned Checked Behavior.

Scope.SCP-IN-001: Checkbox.Checked, OnValueChange, Disabled and Tooltip Props.
Scope.SCP-IN-002: Native checkbox square and its intrinsic measurement.
Scope.SCP-OUT-001: Label text presentation or multi-choice group composition — owned by callers.

Requirements.REQ-001: Checked is an externally authoritative Prop; a native toggle calls OnValueChange only when enabled and the proposed bool differs from Checked.Value.
Requirements.REQ-002: Checkbox never assigns Checked itself, even when native Widgets.Checkbox mutates its temporary ref parameter.
Requirements.REQ-003: Native Widgets.Checkbox respects Disabled; default intrinsic dimensions follow Widgets.CheckboxSize and Flexbox measure modes.

Inputs.IN-001: Checked: bool or Behavior<bool>, Disabled and OnValueChange callback.

Outputs.OUT-001: Proposed new bool delivered via OnValueChange.

SideEffects.EFF-001: Calls OnValueChange for enabled changed input; never mutates external Checked.
